newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two held after cars burn for fourth night in Tours.
newsitem.headline: Two held after cars burn for fourth night in Tours.

text.p: Police arrested two youths on Sunday in possession of petrol bombs in the western city of Tours, where parked cars were set ablaze for the fourth night running in depressed suburban areas, Radio France-Info said.
The two, who were not identified, were held after a chase during which one of the youths threw a petrol bomb at his pursuers but missed them, the radio said.

The arrests occurred after seven cars were set ablaze by unidentified attackers late on Saturday and early on Sunday, bringing to about 30 the number of vehicles destroyed in the past few days, the radio said.
The reasons for the violence were not immediately known.
